learning_objective: The learner can apply prompt engineering best practices such as crafting detailed instructions, providing examples, systematically testing changes, versioning prompts, and standardizing evaluation metrics.

common_misconceptions.description: Believing prompt engineering is not a real skill or technique despite it being a common model adaptation method.
Thinking prompt engineering is the only skill needed to build production-ready AI applications, ignoring statistics, engineering, and ML knowledge.
Relying on superficial tricks like promising a tip or using shorthand labels instead of systematic best practices for effective prompts.
Assuming a prompt that improves a model's performance on a subtask will necessarily improve the performance of the whole system.
